1: // game.js - Simple Pixel Dodger
2: // Canvas with id "game" assumed in HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Player ship
11:   const ship = { x: width / 2 - 10, y: height - 30, size: 20, speed: 4, shield: 0 };
12: 
13:   // Input handling
14:   const keys = {};
15:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
16:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
17: 
18:   // Game objects
19:   const asteroids = [];
20:   const powerUps = [];
21:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
22:   let lastPower = 0;
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let startTime = performance.now();
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   function spawnAsteroid() {
28:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 15;
29:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
30:   }
31: 
32:   function spawnPower() {
33:     const size = 12;
34:     powerUps.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 });
35:   }
36: 
37:   function update(dt) {
38:     // Move ship
39:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
40:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
41:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
42:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
43:     // keep inside bounds
44:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
45:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.size, ship.y));
46: 
47:     // Spawn asteroids every 800ms
48:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroid > 800) { spawnAsteroid(); lastAsteroid = performance.now(); }
49:     // Spawn power‑up every 8000ms
50:     if (performance.now() - lastPower > 8000) { spawnPower(); lastPower = performance.now(); }
51: 
52:     // Update asteroids
53:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
54:       const a = asteroids[i];
55:       a.y += a.speed;
56:       if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
57:     }
58:     // Update power‑ups
59:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
60:       const p = powerUps[i];
61:       p.y += p.speed;
62:       if (p.y > height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
63:     }
64: 
65:     // Collision detection
66:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
67:       const a = asteroids[i];
68:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) {
69:         if (ship.shield > 0) {
70:           // destroy asteroid, consume shield
71:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
72:           ship.shield--;
73:         } else {
74:           gameOver = true;
75:         }
76:         break;
77:       }
78:     }
79:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
80:       const p = powerUps[i];
81:       if (rectIntersect(ship, p)) {
82:         ship.shield = 3; // grant 3‑frame shield
83:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
84:         break;
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // Score based on survival time
89:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
90:   }
91: 
92:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
93:     return a.x < b.x + b.size && a.x + a.size > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.size && a.y + a.size > b.y;
94:   }
95: 
96:   function draw() {
97:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
98:     // ship
99:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield > 0 ? 'cyan' : 'white';
100:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.size, ship.size);
101:     // asteroids
102:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
103:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.size, a.size));
104:     // power‑ups
105:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
106:     powerUps.forEach(p => ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size));
107:     // score
108:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
109:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
110:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
111:     // shield indicator
112:     if (ship.shield > 0) {
113:       ctx.fillText('Shield: ' + ship.shield, 10, 40);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function loop(timestamp) {
118:     if (gameOver) {
119:       ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
120:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
121:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
122:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
123:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
124:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
125:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, width / 2 - 70, height / 2 + 30);
126:       return;
127:     }
128:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
129:     lastFrame = timestamp;
130:     update(dt);
131:     draw();
132:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133:   }
134:   let lastFrame = null;
135:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
136: })();
